title: Our Services | Saylani Welfare Trust
text:
Saylani Welfare International Trust groups its programs into the following service categories, per its official 'About' page:

Healthcare - comprehensive medical services including hospitals, clinics, blood banks, and specialized care programs: Health Department, Mother & Child Care Center, Blood Bank, Medical Equipment, Old Age Home, Laboratory Facility, X-Ray & Ultrasound, Mobile Health Clinic.

Education - modern educational programs from basic literacy to advanced IT training and vocational skills: Saylani Schooling System, Online Quran Academy, Madarsa-e-Faizan-e-Mustafa, SMIT Program, PIAIC, SBIL, Vocational Training, Scholarship Programs.

Food Security - daily meal programs, ration distribution, and emergency food relief: Daily Dastarkhwan, Mobile Food Units, Ramadan Programs, Sadqa Meat Distribution, Roti Bank, Ration Support.

Clean Water - water purification systems, well construction, and sustainable water solutions: RO Water Plants, Water Chillers, Well Digging.

Social Welfare - housing, employment, and community development: Kafalat Program (family adoption / monthly support), Wedding Program (marriage assistance for the needy), Microfinance, Job Bank, Housing Scheme, Masajid Construction.

Disaster Aid - rapid response and relief during natural disasters and emergencies: Disaster Response, Emergency Medical Aid, Flood Relief, Fire Fighting.

Saylani Ehsaas - compassion-driven initiatives providing meals, shelter, and dignity to vulnerable communities: Langar Khana (community kitchen), Panah Gaah (shelter home), and the 'Koi Bhooka Na Soye Ga' (No One Should Sleep Hungry) initiative.
